why: The TQT-PE is a named standardized qualification assessment instrument, not a general instructional element.
name: Teacher Qualification Test for Physical Education (TQT-PE)
product_description: The TQT-PE is a standardized professional qualification examination administered under ÖSYM guidelines to assess prospective physical education and sports teachers’ field knowledge and preparedness for teaching.
